screens.name: Policy Guard Intercept Dialog
screens.purpose: Block non-compliant file writes and prompt user for binary exception decision

regions.label: ⚠ House Rule Violation: [no-cron] Schedule trigger in .github/workflows/deploy.yml
Source: Org no-cron policy (2026-08-08). Scheduled cron triggers cause uncontrolled runner spend.
[1] Refuse the write (Default)   |   [2] Allow this once (Logged to audit)

notes: Default action is Refuse to prevent accidental automated allowance
Headless / non-interactive sessions fail closed automatically
Allowed overrides recorded to persistent audit store with timestamp

Dirty state: Flags uncommitted files in target worktree
Rides as model context to keep orchestrator informed
